task_description: Python backend-only calculation module for FairWatt MA: (1) energy consumption statistics, (2) money-you-could-have-saved vs basic-service rate, (3) per-town map data with a GREEN/GREY/RED traffic-light class. Produces committed static JSON artifacts under data/build/ and a frontend contract doc. No UI/TS/React. Stays within stats/savings/map filenames; does not touch the sibling HMM (hmm*) or Monte-Carlo/all-cities (forecast_mc_*, allcities_*) workflows.
